Indx._LicenseFileComment: Path to your Indx license file. Leave empty to auto-detect *.license files in ./IndxData/. Get a free license at https://license.indx.co or purchase SLA for production.
Indx._LicenseAutoFetchComment: Auto-fetch your license from the Indx portal. Set LicenseDownloadUrl to https://<portal>/api/license/current and LicenseToken to a token created on your portal license page. With a token, a fresh license is fetched on every startup. Set these via env/Key Vault, not here.

Registration._ModeComment: Options: Open (anyone can register), EmailDomain (restrict to specific domains), Closed (no registration)
Registration._AllowedDomainsComment: List of allowed email domains when Mode is EmailDomain. Example: ['yourcompany.com', 'partner.com']

Identity._RequireConfirmedEmailComment: When true, users must confirm their email before signing in. OAuth users (Google/Microsoft) are auto-confirmed since their email is already verified.

Microsoft._Comment: Get credentials from https://portal.azure.com - App Registrations

Email._ProviderComment: Options: Console (logs to console), AzureCommunicationServices, or implement your own IEmailSender
Email._FromAddressComment: IMPORTANT: When using Azure Communication Services, this MUST match a verified domain. See docs/EMAIL_SETUP.md for details.

AzureCommunicationServices._Comment: Get from Azure Portal - Communication Services - Keys
